name: AnimatedContent-TS-TW
title: Animated Content
description: A wrapper that slides its child in from the side or from below, fading and optionally scaling, once the child scrolls into view. The demo applies it to a stack of changelog cards.
use: Sections or cards should arrive as the visitor scrolls, giving a long page a sense of pace.
avoid: Above-the-fold content, which starts hidden, and long lists where repeated reveals slow reading.
a11y: Wrapped content is kept invisible until it scrolls in, and there is no reduced-motion fallback. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark changelog page: a small outlined badge, a bold white heading and a line of grey copy at the top, then a narrow column of rounded dark cards. Each card carries a version tag, a white title and two lines of grey text.
behaves: Each card begins shifted off its resting spot and invisible, then slides, fades and scales into place when it reaches a set point in the viewport. The move fires once per card and scrolling carries on normally.
customise: Wrap anything as children and set distance, direction, reverse, duration, easing, scale, threshold, delay, starting opacity and a fade-out after a delay.
weight: moderate: One GSAP ScrollTrigger and timeline per wrapped element, killed on unmount.
